2: // Canvas with id="game" must exist in the HTML.

4: (() => {
5:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');

7:     console.error('Canvas with id "game" not found');

10:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');

12:   // --- Audio setup ----------------------------------------------------
13:   const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();

16:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
17:     osc.frequency.value = freq;

22:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.2, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.01);

26:   }

33:   // Set canvas size to fill the window (you can adjust as needed)

42:   // --- Starfield -----------------------------------------------------
43:   const stars = [];
44:   function initStars() {
45:     const count = Math.floor((canvas.width * canvas.height) / 8000);

48:       stars.push({
49:         x: Math.random() * canvas.width,
50:         y: Math.random() * canvas.height,
51:         radius: Math.random() * 1.5 + 0.5,
52:         twinkle: Math.random() * 0.5 + 0.5,
53:       });
54:     }
55:   }
56:   function drawStars() {
57:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
58:     for (const s of stars) {
59:       ctx.globalAlpha = s.twinkle * (0.5 + Math.random() * 0.5);
60:       ctx.beginPath();
61:       ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);

63:     }

68:   // --- Game state -----------------------------------------------------
69:   const ship = {

80:   const asteroids = [];

86:   let gameOver = false;

89:   let audioStarted = false;

95:   }

102:     if (e.code === 'ArrowRight') {
103:       ship.turningRight = true;

107:   });
108:   window.addEventListener('keyup', (e) => {
109:     if (e.code === 'ArrowLeft') ship.turningLeft = false;

113:   // --- Helper functions ------------------------------------------------
114:   function spawnAsteroid() {
115:     const radius = 15 + Math.random() * 20;
116:     const x = Math.random() * (canvas.width - radius * 2) + radius;

118:     const angle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;

120:     const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(0, 0, radius * 0.2, 0, 0, radius);
121:     grad.addColorStop(0, '#777');
122:     grad.addColorStop(1, '#222');
123:     asteroids.push({ x, y, radius, angle, angularSpeed, grad });
124:   }

126:   function update(delta) {
127:     if (gameOver) return;
128: 
129:     // Ship rotation
130:     if (ship.turningLeft) ship.angle -= ship.turnSpeed;
131:     if (ship.turningRight) ship.angle += ship.turnSpeed;
132: 
133:     // Ship forward motion (constant speed)
134:     ship.x += Math.cos(ship.angle) * ship.speed;
135:     ship.y += Math.sin(ship.angle) * ship.speed;

137:     // Keep ship inside canvas (wrap around horizontally)
138:     if (ship.x < 0) ship.x = canvas.width;
139:     if (ship.x > canvas.width) ship.x = 0;
140:     if (ship.y < 0) ship.y = canvas.height;
141:     if (ship.y > canvas.height) ship.y = 0;

143:     // Spawn asteroids
144:     if (performance.now() - lastAsteroidTime > asteroidInterval) {
145:       spawnAsteroid();
146:       lastAsteroidTime = performance.now();
147:     }
148: 
149:     // Move asteroids (including rotation)
150:     for (const a of asteroids) {
151:       a.y += asteroidSpeed;
152:       a.angle += a.angularSpeed;
153:     }
154:     // Remove off‑screen asteroids
155:     while (asteroids.length && asteroids[0].y - asteroids[0].radius > canvas.height) {
156:       asteroids.shift();

160:     for (const a of asteroids) {
161:       const dx = a.x - ship.x;
162:       const dy = a.y - ship.y;
163:       const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
164:       if (dist < a.radius + ship.radius) {

169:     }
170:   }

173:     ctx.save();
174:     ctx.translate(ship.x, ship.y);
175:     ctx.rotate(ship.angle);

177:     const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, -ship.radius, 0, ship.radius);
178:     grad.addColorStop(0, '#0ff');
179:     grad.addColorStop(1, '#006');
180:     ctx.fillStyle = grad;
181:     ctx.beginPath();
182:     ctx.moveTo(0, -ship.radius);
183:     ctx.lineTo(ship.radius * 0.7, ship.radius);
184:     ctx.lineTo(-ship.radius * 0.7, ship.radius);
185:     ctx.closePath();

187:     ctx.restore();

192:       ctx.save();
193:       ctx.translate(a.x, a.y);
194:       ctx.rotate(a.angle);
195:       ctx.fillStyle = a.grad;

211:     ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.6)';
212:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
213:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';

217:     const finalScore = ((performance.now() - startTime) / 1000).toFixed(2);
218:     ctx.font = '32px sans-serif';

223:     if (!startTime) startTime = timestamp;
224:     const delta = timestamp - (lastRender || timestamp);

229:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);

232:     drawShip();
233:     drawAsteroids();

235:

238:     } else {
239:       requestAnimationFrame(loop);
240:     }
241:   }
